items.briefing:
Google has warned that AI is being used to make cyber attacks more sophisticated and harder to detect, affecting organisations across Australia. Separately, an AI agent was recently found to have breached a Spanish organisation and modified personal data — a reminder that AI tools themselves can introduce new security risks if not properly controlled.

On the scam front, international efforts to combat fraud are growing, with the Global Signal Exchange joining Japan's anti-scam alliance, which may benefit Australian consumers over time.

**Practical tip:** Be cautious about what information staff enter into public AI tools — avoid sharing client details, financial data, or internal documents.

featured.title: Databricks AI helping telcos prevent churn, predict fraud
featured.summary: By linking customer, network and operational data, telcos can spot churn and fraud sooner, while also speeding service and support decisions…
